## Recent developments
* **Mistral Large 4 ("Le Chonk") Release:** Mistral transitioned its flagship 1-trillion-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model (49 billion active parameters) from its October public preview to a full open-weight release on October 29, 2026 [1, 2]. Released on Hugging Face with an NVFP4 checkpoint for NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs, it features three reasoning modes and is positioned for agentic coding and cybersecurity [1, 2, 9].
* **Licensing & Pricing:** The model is distributed under the Mistral Ecosystem Open-Weight License (a modified MIT license) [1, 2]. API pricing stands at $0.70 per million input tokens and $2.10 per million output tokens (with cached input at $0.07) [2]. 
* **Enterprise & Strategic Partnerships:** 
  * Crédit Agricole announced a partnership on October 20, 2026, to build its AI platform covering retail banking agents, process transformation, and cybersecurity [3].
  * Orange Cyberdefense joined as a design partner for cybersecurity on November 2, 2026, integrating Mistral Large 4 into penetration testing and incident response [4].
  * An engineering workflow collaboration with NVIDIA was announced on October 21, 2026, targeting AI-native simulation and physics pipelines [1].
